import numpy as np, mujoco as mj
from scipy.optimize import least_squares
from scipy.spatial.transform import Rotation
import casa_tool, sys
s=casa_tool.Session('/app/instance.npz'); m=s.model
site=m.site('gripper0_right_grip_site').id
armadrs=[m.joint('robot0_joint'+str(i)).qposadr[0] for i in range(1,8)]
limits=np.array([m.joint('robot0_joint'+str(i)).range for i in range(1,8)])
work=mj.MjData(m)
def pose(q):
    np.copyto(work.qpos,s.data.qpos)
    work.qpos[armadrs]=q
    mj.mj_forward(m,work)
    return work.site_xpos[site].copy(),work.site_xmat[site].reshape(3,3).copy()
def ik(pos,rot=None):
    q0=s.data.qpos[armadrs].copy()
    if rot is None: rot=s.data.site_xmat[site].reshape(3,3).copy()
    def err(q):
        p,R=pose(q)
        e=np.r_[6*(p-pos),Rotation.from_matrix(rot@R.T).as_rotvec(),0.08*(q-q0)]
        return e
    r=least_squares(err,q0,bounds=(limits[:,0]+1e-3,limits[:,1]-1e-3),max_nfev=70,ftol=1e-4)
    return r.x,np.linalg.norm(r.fun[:3])/6

def act(q=None,grip=-1,base=(0,0,0),torso=0,mode=-1):
    if q is None:q=s.data.qpos[armadrs].copy()
    a=np.r_[q,grip,base,torso,mode]
    s.step(a)
    return a

def move(pos,n=30,grip=-1,rot=None):
    start=s.data.site_xpos[site].copy()
    for i in range(n):
        p=start+(np.array(pos)-start)*(i+1)/n
        q,e=ik(p,rot)
        act(q,grip)
    print('move',pos,'actual',s.data.site_xpos[site], 'err',e,'obj',s.state()['bodies']['tupperware_main']['pos'],flush=True)

def hold(n,grip=-1):
    for i in range(n):act(grip=grip)

def log(label):
    st=s.state();print(label,'eef',np.round(st['bodies']['gripper0_right_eef']['pos'],3),'tupper',np.round(st['bodies']['tupperware_main']['pos'],3),'meat',np.round(st['bodies']['meat_main']['pos'],3),'base',np.round(st['bodies']['mobilebase0_base']['pos'],3),'success',s.check(),flush=True)

log('initial')

move([4.08,-0.59,1.045],30)
hold(20,grip=1)
log('grasp')
move([4.08,-0.59,1.30],35,grip=1)
log('lift')
s.save_trajectory()
